QUESTION: How to get the 630 worth-ingesting recordings + existing MDs into the memory system as globals?
CONTEXT: No direct POST endpoint for memories. Writing directly to disk bypasses embeddings and manager.
BLOCKERS: Feeding through curator costs Sonnet tokens. Qwen can't reliably generate the full memory schema.
OPTIONS: 1) Have conversations about recordings/MDs and let hooks capture naturally 2) Build script to format as fake transcripts and feed through curator 3) Batch recordings by theme and curate in chunks
